title: Make Your Studio Feel Twice as Big: 7 Renter-Friendly Habits
description: Small studio apartment? These 7 renter-friendly habits make a tiny space feel twice as big - no drilling, no damage-deposit drama. Weekend tweaks for renters: layout, mirrors, storage, and lighting.
